working_on.notes: Added dynamic pronoun templates based on age and a global back button that traces screen history.

recent_changes.description: Implemented serverless API proxies (api/upload.js & api/submit.js) for security and squelched Vercel 413 Payload error with JPEG compression API rules.
Implemented Dynamic Pronouns based on age criteria and added global back navigation via history state array.

errors_encountered.solution: Changed Health_Status field in NocoDB from MultiSelect to LongText to accept arbitrary concatenated string data.

errors_encountered.error: Vercel Payload Too Large (413) on Image Uploads
errors_encountered.solution: Canvas compression forced to image/jpeg (0.8 quality). Vercel serverless size limit explicitly adjusted to 4mb.

errors_encountered.error: Có lỗi khi gửi thông tin (Failed to fetch)
errors_encountered.solution: App.submitForm was still using deleted CONFIG.NOCODB_API. Fixed to fetch('/api/submit') using Vercel Serverless proxy.

decisions_made.decision: Use Vercel serverless endpoints instead of NocoDB direct REST
decisions_made.reason: Crucial requirement to completely hide standard NOCODB_TOKEN and IMGBB_KEY API secrets from public client context

decisions_made.decision: Use history array for backward navigation
decisions_made.reason: Provides a robust way to go back to the exact previous screen without hardcoding previous screen logic for every step.

decisions_made.decision: Use declarative data-template attributes for easy dynamic text resolution.
decisions_made.reason: Keeps HTML clean and cleanly handles replacing variables like {bot} and {user} across elements when age is selected.
